llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究耐热铝合金的激光选区熔化工艺，与生物医学植入物方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure design, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no osseointegration or fatigue testing relevant to implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究耐热铝合金SLM成形件的微观结构与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Al-Fe-V-Si合金并表征其组织与性能。
summary_zh.result: 获得了高致密度和良好力学性能的SLM成形铝合金件。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量、显微组织和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of heat-resistant Al-Fe-V-Si aluminum alloy components fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Al-Fe-V-Si alloy samples were prepared by SLM and characterized using microscopy, density measurement, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The SLM-processed alloy achieved high relative density and favorable mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through density measurement, microstructural analysis, and mechanical testing including hardness and compression.
